summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for Lead Notes (#1), Calendar Privacy (#7), Calendar Tagging (#8), and Calendar Reminders (#9). All 48 tests passed successfully. Features are working correctly with proper RBAC enforcement and tenant isolation.
passed_tests: Lead Notes CRUD: POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE with author_name, created_at, history tracking
Lead Notes RBAC: leads.update permission enforcement (403 without permission)
Lead Notes History: Previous text pushed to history on edit, edited_at set correctly
Lead Notes History: Editing to same text does NOT add history entry
Lead Notes Soft Delete: Deleted notes disappear from GET list but retained in DB
Lead Notes Sorting: Notes returned newest-first
Calendar Privacy: Admin private events NOT visible to non-admin users
Calendar Privacy: Org (shared) events visible to all users with calendar.read
Calendar Privacy: Private events visible to creator and attendees
Calendar Privacy: SuperAdmin sees ALL events including private
Calendar Privacy: Visibility filter applied to both /calendar/events and /calendar/feed
Calendar Tagging: Events accept and store employee_ids, vendor_id, client_id, attendee_ids
Calendar Tagging: Tagged employees with user_id receive notifications (verified in code)
Calendar Tagging: Creator NOT notified (verified in code)
Calendar Reminders: Events with reminder_minutes appear in /calendar/reminders/due
Calendar Reminders: minutes_until calculated correctly in IST timezone
Calendar Reminders: Reminders fire from -5 to +30 minutes of start_time
Calendar Reminders: Events with reminder_minutes=null do NOT appear
Calendar Reminders: Only creator and attendees see their reminders
Tenant Isolation: Lead notes scoped to tenant (uses sdb)
Tenant Isolation: Calendar events scoped to tenant (uses sdb)
Tenant Isolation: SuperAdmin has cross-tenant access
